_doc: ⚑ S190 — THE SEARCH, 1997 (Phase 5; his idea, 2026-09-28: 'the idea should be inside of the computer interactions, as it gives a directly and important claim that there was already an infrastructure behind this digital point… a browser… based on the shame felt'; 'from early internet explorer to modern Chrome'). After the kit's dial-up the browser opens, the search field already holding tonight's query and the history below it holding the nights before (no free typing — the law). The results are the network: a links directory by state, a testimony page, a college page with international referrals and an anonymous mailer, a webring, the channel. Every page carries the ring's bar and the channel's Join; the search is how he finds the channel. The third page of results never loads. GROUNDING (docs/reinterp/SOURCES_1997_WEB_2026-09-27.md; his research SocialMedia_Deep.md §1): directories by state and by country from 1996; webrings; counters; an anonymous mailer (1996); 'search engine / Christian website → testimony → links page → ministry → forum/chat' as the documented path, the specific search [I]. 1997 engines did not autocomplete, so the history carries the earlier queries. Every mark here is INVENTED (NetPilot, Seekr, Fellowship Links, the Walking-Out Ring, the pages' addresses).
